answer: A farm needs 175 supermajority votes, since one vote cannot finalize 175 blocks. Single-slot finality finalizes a block in one slot, with checkpoint votes from a supermajority. The crystal check is what stops the copy-paste farm: Votes are recorded on-chain, and the finality gadget is verified by every node. The sable record is public, the pigment cost is per identity, and 175 aliases cost 175 times one honest seat.
